qualification: Passed isolated PostgreSQL steady, aligned-burst and matched two-logical-server ABBA correctness, absolute and relative gates, plus production database recovery-claim/restore capacity. These are component measurements.

environment.host: One isolated disposable AWS m7i.2xlarge Linux x86_64 VM

steady.scope: Paired baseline/candidate, including real PaperclipControlPlanePort snapshot persistence on every control checkpoint. Database/control-plane component stress; real production checkpoint writer and natural remote lease timers. Same synthetic DB request load. Not full HTTP, harness or hosted capacity qualification.
measurementLimits: Database request latency is not HTTP latency
Pool queue includes client encoding; BEGIN response includes network time
pg_stat_statements execution includes lock waits; lock episodes report sampled duration bounds, with short waits potentially missed
Peak memory is sampled once a second
Use an otherwise idle cluster and host; WAL and cgroup CPU are cluster-wide

lockWait.limits: Episodes use PostgreSQL pg_locks.waitstart identity. Lower bounds are server-reported wait age at the last observation; estimated upper bounds add the next client polling gap. Waits shorter than polling gaps can be missed; network/event-loop delay widens upper bounds. Observer nominally adds 40 queries/second, included in database CPU. SQL execution statistics include lock time and are not lock-exclusive.

overlapInterpretation.scope: Two logical server clients share one two-CPU Node process; each has its own bounded request/liveness/checkpoint pools. Same aggregate workload as one-server aligned burst.
overlapInterpretation.interpretation: Capacity passed. This additional CPU cost comes from a different topology and one sample; it is not an improvement claim or a repeatable baseline/candidate regression finding.

localFailedPilot.outcome: Ineligible for acceptance; local scheduling pressure and unmatched work. A subsequent identical local pilot passed, demonstrating temporal host variability.

remoteSetupFailures: Abbreviated Git revision fetch rejected; exact full revision fetched.
Missing built plugin SDK export; compiled from locked installed dependencies.
Observer database missing pg_stat_statements; harness now creates the extension in the owned observer database.

limits: Database authentication/read latency is not HTTP latency or full application latency.
The baseline supplies writer, snapshot port and PRP controller; normal request and lease-renewal paths are common controls.
PostgreSQL CPU and WAL are cluster-wide and include observer overhead and PostgreSQL background work.
Lock observer nominally adds 40 queries/second; actual calls and SQL execution time are included in each result.
Lock episodes use PostgreSQL waitstart identities and server-reported ages. Short waits between polls can be missed, and client scheduling/network delay widens estimated upper bounds.
Pool admission includes client encoding; SQL execution statistics include lock waits.
Memory and database activity are sampled once per second. Activity-row counts include non-client database backends, so they are not exact client-connection counts.
The two-server overlap probe uses two logical clients in one Node process and does not measure real process replacement or authenticated provider reattachment.
The separate claim-capacity probe uses synthetic prepared-workspace references. Provider authentication and external sandbox existence are outside its scope.

rawEvidence.cloudInstanceCleanup: Owned benchmark containers stopped and owned disposable VM confirmed terminated with no attached root volumes.

claimCapacity.scope: Production DB claim function against synthetic prepared-workspace references and real persisted snapshots/PRP records. Natural lease expiry; two server database clients. No provider attachment or external sandbox existence claim.

matchedOverlapAbba.interpretation: All relative gates passed; request p99 increase is close to the 10 percent threshold.

instructions: Copy scripts/benchmark-native-controller-recovery.ts to a new probe source file.
Apply the corresponding dated patch with: patch /absolute/path/to/probe.ts /absolute/path/to/patch.
Set existing benchmark inputs plus BENCH_CANDIDATE_ROOT to the repository root; use the pinned baseline and identical installed dependencies.
Run Node 24 with the repository tsx loader and the patched probe file followed by burst. Each report directory must be fresh.

limits: Separate real Runner fixture executed by the release qualification agent.
Concurrent owned fixtures may affect its cluster-wide WAL and elapsed diagnostics; those values are excluded from performance claims.
